This R script is for NO3, NH4, protease activity, bglucosidase activity and desaminase activity quantification of the synthetic soil 2 weeks after necromass addition.

# Nitrate
## Function 
```{r}
no3 <- function(std_file, data_file, intercept = NULL, slope = NULL, label_name = "concentration") {

if (is.character(std_file)) {
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("numeric","text", "numeric"))
} else {
std_data <- std_file
}
  

if (is.character(data_file)) {
no3_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text", "text", "numeric"))
} else {
no3_data <- data_file
}
  
# Standard curve
ggplot(std_data, aes(x = Standard, y = od540)) +
geom_point() +
stat_cor(label.y = 1.0, r.accuracy = 0.0001) +
stat_regline_equation(label.y = 0.8) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", alpha = 0.15, colour = "darkgrey") +
labs(x = "Nitrate concentraion (mg/L)", y = "Absorbance (540 nm)") +
theme_bw()
  
#standard curve  
std1 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "2")
  
# Models
model1 <- lm(od540 ~ Standard, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(od540 ~ Standard, data = std2)
  
# Samples
sample1 <- no3_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od540 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
sample2 <- no3_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od540 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
      
# blank mean
mean_blank <- bind_rows(sample1, sample2) %>%
  filter(sample == "bl") %>%
  pull(concentration) %>%
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# Duplicates
mean_conc <- (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2
# blank correction
if (!is.na(mean_blank) && mean_blank > 0) {
mean_conc <- mean_conc - mean_blank
} 


result <- sample1[1:length(mean_conc), "sample"]
result[[label_name]] <- mean_conc
return(result)} 

```

##Nitrate
```{r}

tf_soilno3 <- no3(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std-no3_synthetique_final.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/no3_synthetique_final.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationsoil")

```

## Data transformation
```{r}
#Creating a dataframe without blank
tf_soilno3 <- tf_soilno3 %>% filter(sample != "bl") 

# mg/mL to mg/g soil conversion
# KCl extraction: 1 g of soil in 10 mL of KCl
no3_tf <- tf_soilno3 %>%
mutate(across(starts_with("concentrationsoil"), ~ .x * 0.01, .names = "{.col}_mg_g")) 

no3_tf <- no3_tf[, c("sample", "concentrationsoil_mg_g")]

write_xlsx(no3_tf, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/no3_concentration_synthetic.xlsx")
```

# Ammonium
## Function 
```{r}
nh4 <- function(std_file, data_file, intercept = NULL, slope = NULL, label_name = "concentration") {

if (is.character(std_file)) {
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("numeric", "text","numeric"))
} else {
std_data <- std_file
}

if (is.character(data_file)) {
nh4_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text", "text", "text", "numeric"))
} else {
nh4_data <- data_file
}
  
#Remove the 20 mg/L from the standard curve
std_data <- std_data[std_data$Standard != 20, ]

#standard curve  
std1 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "2")
  
# Models
model1 <- lm(od660 ~ Standard, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(od660 ~ Standard, data = std2)
  
# Samples
sample1 <- nh4_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od660 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
sample2 <- nh4_data %>%  dplyr::filter(replicat == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od660 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
      
# Mean blank
mean_blank <- bind_rows(sample1, sample2) %>%
  filter(sample == "bl") %>%
  pull(concentration) %>%
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# Duplicate
mean_conc <- (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2
  # Blank Correction
  if (!is.na(mean_blank) && mean_blank > 0) {
    mean_conc <- mean_conc - mean_blank
  } 

  result <- sample1[1:length(mean_conc), "sample"]
  result[[label_name]] <- mean_conc
  return(result)
}
```

### Diluted sample ammonium
```{r}
# Reprise nh4
nh4dil <- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Raw_data/nh4_reprise-synthetique.xlsx", col_types = c("text","numeric","text","numeric"))

# Standards
stdnh4dil <- nh4dil[1:20, ]

# Samples 
samplenh4dil <- nh4dil[21:32, ]

#  Remove the 20 mg/L from the standard curve
std_data <- stdnh4dil[stdnh4dil$Standard != 20, ]

# Model
model1 <- lm(od660 ~ Standard, data = std_data)
  
# Samples
sample <- samplenh4dil %>% mutate(concentration = (od660 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
# Blank mean
mean_blank <- sample %>%
filter(sample == "bl") %>%
pull(concentration) %>%
mean(na.rm = TRUE)%>%
max(0, .) 

#Duplicates
sample1 <- sample %>% filter(replicat == "1") 
sample2 <- sample %>% filter(replicat == "2") 
mean_conc <- (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2
# Blank Correction
mean_conc <- mean_conc - mean_blank


reprise_nh4 <- sample1[1:length(mean_conc), "sample"]
reprise_nh4$concentrationsoil <- mean_conc

#  undiluted concentration ( with dilution factor)
reprise_nh4$concentrationsoil<-(reprise_nh4$concentrationsoil*500)/100
  
```

## Replace the sample undiluted by the one diluted
```{r}

tfnh4_soil <- tfnh4_soil %>%
rows_update(reprise_nh4, by = "sample")

```

## Data transformation
```{r}
#Creating a dataframe without blank
tfnh4_soil <- tfnh4_soil %>% filter(sample != "bl") 

# mg/mL to mg/g soil conversion
# KCl extraction: 1 g of soil in 10 mL of KCl
nh4_tf <- tfnh4_soil %>%
mutate(across(starts_with("concentrationsoil"), ~ .x * 0.01, .names = "{.col}_mg_g")) 

nh4_tf <- nh4_tf[, c("sample", "concentrationsoil_mg_g")]

write_xlsx(nh4_tf, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/nh4_concentration_synthetic.xlsx")
```

# Protease activity
## Function 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
protease <- function(std_file, data_file, label_name, labelenzyme) {
# Data
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("numeric", "text", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric","numeric", "numeric"))
prot_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text","text", "numeric", "numeric","numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"))

#Standard curve
std1 <- std_data %>% filter(as.character(type) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% filter(as.character(type) == "2")
stdcontrol <- std_data %>% filter(as.character(type) == "control")
  
# models
model1 <- lm(od650 ~ Standards, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(od650 ~ Standards, data = std2)
modelcontrol <- lm(od650 ~ Standards, data = stdcontrol)

# Samples
sample1 <- prot_data %>% filter(rep == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od650 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
sample2 <- prot_data %>% filter(rep == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od650 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
  
control <- prot_data %>% filter(rep == "bl") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od650 - coef(modelcontrol)[1]) / coef(modelcontrol)[2]) %>% dplyr::select(sample, concentration)

  
# duplicates
mean_conc <- full_join(sample1, sample2, by = "sample", suffix = c(".1", ".2")) %>%
transmute(
sample = sample,
!!label_name := (concentration.1 + concentration.2) / 2)

# Blank correction
result <- mean_conc %>%
left_join(control, by = "sample") %>%
mutate(
!!label_name := .data[[label_name]] - concentration ) %>%
dplyr::select(sample, !!label_name)


# Now, we are in mmol/L of tyrosine based on the standard curve
#conversion in uM/L
C <- result[[label_name]]*1000

# Calculate enzymatic activity (μmol tyrosine g−1 dry soil h−1)
## Step 1: (molar concentration * volume color (0.5mL supernatant + 0.75mL NA2CO3 + 0.25 mL Folin = 0.0015L)) 
C<- (C*0.0015) # =umol

## Step 2: Alliquot correction: umol * (10mL(TCA+TRIS+Caseinate/0.5mL(alliquot for the coloration step)))
C<- C*(10/0.5)

## Step 3: Normalization with soil masse and incubation time (soil weight= 1 g, time= 2 h)
enzymact <- C/(1 * 2)  #μmol tyrosine g−1 dry soil h−1

# Creating a dataframe
result <- result %>%
mutate(!!paste0(labelenzyme, "_activity") := enzymact)


return(result)}

```

##Protease
```{r}

# First batch
b1a1b3a6_soilprot <- protease(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std-synthetique-protease-b1a1-b3a6.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/protease-synthetique-b1a1_b3a6.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationsoil",
  labelenzyme = "soil")

# Second batch
b3f1b5f6_soilprot <- protease(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std-synthetique-protease-b3f1-b5f6.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/protease-synthetique-b3f1_b5f6.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationsoil",
  labelenzyme = "soil")

```

## Diluted sample
```{r}
dilprot<- read_excel("synthetic_soil/Raw_data/protease-reprise-synthetique-final.xlsx", col_types = c("text","numeric","text", "numeric", "numeric","numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"))

# Standards
stdprotdil <- dilprot[1:32, ]

# Samples 
sampleprotdil <- dilprot[33:38, ]

model1 <- lm(od650 ~ Standard, data = stdprotdil)
  
sample <- sampleprotdil %>% mutate(concentration = (od650 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])

# Duplicate
sample1 <- sample %>% filter(rep == "1.d") 
sample2 <- sample %>% filter(rep == "2.d") 
mean_conc <- (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2
 
reprise_prot <- sample1[1:length(mean_conc), "sample"]
reprise_prot$concentrationsoil <- mean_conc

reprise_prot$concentrationsoil <- (((reprise_prot$concentrationsoil)*1000)/200)

C2<- reprise_prot$concentrationsoil*1000 
C2<- (C2*0.0015)
C2<- C2*(10/0.5)
enzymact2 <- C2/(1 * 2)
reprise_prot$'soil_activity'<- enzymact2
```


## Data transformation
```{r}
tfprot <- rbind(b1a1b3a6_soilprot, b3f1b5f6_soilprot)
tfprot <- tfprot %>% filter(sample != "bl") 
tfprot <- tfprot %>% dplyr::select(sample, soil_activity)
reprise_prot <- reprise_prot %>% dplyr :: select(sample, soil_activity)

tfprot <- tfprot %>%
rows_update(reprise_prot, by = "sample")

write_xlsx(tfprot, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/protease_activity_synthetic.xlsx")
```

# Bglucosidase
## Function 
```{r}

bgluco<- function(std_file, data_file, label_name,labelenzyme) {

# Importing data
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("text", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric","numeric"))
bgluco_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text","text", "numeric", "numeric","numeric", "numeric"))
  
#standard curve  
std_data <- std_data %>%
dplyr::filter(conc != 0.5)
std1 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "2")
stdcontrol <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(plate) == "3")
  
# Models
model1 <- lm(od415 ~ conc, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(od415 ~ conc, data = std2)
modelcontrol <- lm(od415 ~ conc, data = stdcontrol)
  
# Samples
sample1 <- bgluco_data %>%  dplyr::filter(Rep == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od415 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
sample2 <- bgluco_data %>%  dplyr::filter(Rep == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od415 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
  
control <- bgluco_data %>%  dplyr::filter(Rep == "bl") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od415 - coef(modelcontrol)[1]) / coef(modelcontrol)[2])%>%
dplyr::select(sample, concentration)
  
# Duplicates
samples_mean <- tibble(
sample = sample1$sample,
concentration_moyenne = (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2)


result <- samples_mean %>%
left_join(control, by = "sample") %>%
mutate(!!label_name := concentration_moyenne - concentration) %>%
dplyr::select(sample, !!label_name)

# Molar concentration
C <- result[[label_name]] / 139.11  # p-nitrophenol molar mass

#umol
C <- C*1e6

# Calculate enzymatic activity (μmol p-nitrophenol g−1 dry soil h−1)
# Formula: (molar concentration * volume) / (soil weight * incubation time)
enzymact <- (C * 0.00525) / (1 * 1)  # volume = 0.00525L, soil weight= 1 g, time= 1 h


result <- result %>%
mutate(!!paste0(labelenzyme, "_activity") := enzymact)


return(result)}

```

# Desaminase activity
# Function 
```{r}
desaminase<- function(std_file, data_file, label_name) {

# Importing data
std_data <- read_excel(std_file, col_types = c("numeric", "numeric", "text"))
des_data <- read_excel(data_file, col_types = c("text","text", "numeric"))
  
#standard curve  
std1 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(Plate) == "1")
std2 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(Plate) == "2")
std3 <- std_data %>% dplyr::filter(as.character(Plate) == "3")
  
# Models
model1 <- lm(OD405 ~ Standards, data = std1)
model2 <- lm(OD405 ~ Standards, data = std2)
model3 <- lm(OD405 ~ Standards, data = std3)
  
# Samples
samplep1 <- des_data %>% dplyr::filter(Rep == "1") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od405 - coef(model1)[1]) / coef(model1)[2])
  
samplep2 <- des_data %>% dplyr::filter(Rep == "2") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od405 - coef(model2)[1]) / coef(model2)[2])
  
samplep3 <- des_data %>% dplyr::filter(Rep == "bl") %>%
mutate(concentration = (od405 - coef(model3)[1]) / coef(model3)[2]) 

  
sample_all <- bind_rows(samplep1, samplep2, samplep3)
  
sample1 <- sample_all %>% dplyr::filter(Rep == "1")
sample2 <- sample_all %>% dplyr::filter(Rep == "2")
control <- sample_all %>% dplyr::filter(Rep == "bl")
  
# Duplicates
samples_mean <- tibble(
sample = sample1$sample,
concentration_moyenne = (sample1$concentration + sample2$concentration) / 2)


result <- samples_mean %>%
dplyr::left_join(control, by = "sample") %>%
mutate(!!label_name := concentration_moyenne - concentration) %>%
mutate(!!label_name := ifelse(!!sym(label_name) < 0, NA, !!sym(label_name))) %>%
dplyr::select(sample, !!label_name)

return(result)}

```

## Desaminase
```{r}

# First batch
b1a1b3a6_soildes <- desaminase(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std-synthetique-des-b1a1-b3a6.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/des-synthetique-b1a1_b3a6.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationsoil")

b3f1b5f6_soildes <- desaminase(
  std_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/std-synthetique-des-b3f1-b5f6.xlsx",
  data_file = "synthetic_soil/Raw_data/des-synthetique-b3f1_b5f6.xlsx",
  label_name = "concentrationsoil")
```

# Data transformation
```{r}
#Creating a dataframe without blank
tfdes <- rbind(b1a1b3a6_soildes, b3f1b5f6_soildes)
tfdes <- tfdes %>% dplyr::filter(sample != "bl") 

#Enzyme activity Deaminase activity is express as rate of substrate deaminated per gram of soil.
tfdes$nondilconcsoil <- ((tfdes$concentrationsoil)*40.25)/10.25
initialconc <- 60
tfdes$enzymeactsoil<- initialconc - tfdes$nondilconcsoil

# Samples were diluted 2 time in methanol (15ml each time).  C1V1=C2V2 C1 =? V1=10,25ml C2=concentration determiner V2=40.25ml (15+15+10.25)
tfdes <- tfdes %>% dplyr::select(sample, enzymeactsoil)

write_xlsx(tfdes, path = "synthetic_soil/Results/desaminase_activity_synthetic.xlsx")

```
